name: TADPOLE Challenge
description: A crowdsourced challenge providing datasets and evaluation protocols to predict Alzheimer's disease progression from longitudinal imaging and clinical biomarkers.
evaluation_method: MAUC (for diagnosis classification), MAE / RMSE (for continuous clinical scores and imaging biomarkers)
general_score_metric: MAUC for diagnosis prediction; MAE for continuous outcomes (e.g., ADAS-Cog, ventricle volume)
reputation: A well-known community challenge in Alzheimer's disease research with broad use for benchmarking longitudinal prognostic models.
notes: Longitudinal and multimodal data with missingness and variable follow-up; dataset and metrics are focused on classical ML/medical imaging models (not an LLM benchmark); participant protocols and data splits can affect comparability.
